gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-83.77419 35.658059)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] > 1100 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH caverns_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-83.77419, 35.658059), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
raster_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    ST_Distance(
      caverns_point.geom,
      ST_Centroid(ST_Union(ST_Intersection(r.rast, ST_Buffer(caverns_point.geom, 100000))))
    ) AS distance_meters
  FROM
    caverns_point,
    public.dem_us r
  WHERE
    ST_Intersects(r.rast, caverns_point.geom)
    AND ST_Value(r.rast, 1, ST_Transform(caverns_point.geom, ST_SRID(r.rast))) < 1100
    AND ST_Value(r.rast, 1, ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(r.rast), ST_SRID(r.rast))) > 1100
)
SELECT
  ROUND(distance_meters / 1000, 2) AS distance_km
FROM
  raster_analysis;
